name: Creative Writing Agent
description: Blog posts, long reads and social updates from a topic, tone and style guide.

fields.label: Topic and angle
fields.placeholder: What is it about, and what is the one thing the reader should take away?

fields.label: Audience
fields.placeholder: e.g. programme officers at EU-funded CSOs

fields.label: Style guide / voice notes
fields.placeholder: Paste house style, sample paragraph, banned phrases, must-use terms (optional)

fields.label: Source material and facts you want used
fields.placeholder: Notes, quotes, data you have verified (optional). The agent will not invent facts.

name: Research and Analysis Agent
description: Structured briefs with evidence grading, a source register and explicit gaps.

fields.label: Research question
fields.placeholder: State the decision this research should inform.

fields.label: Scope and constraints
fields.placeholder: Geography, period, sectors, what is out of scope (optional)

fields.label: Output
options: Research plan only (what to look for, where)

fields.label: Sources and data you have (paste text, links, figures)
fields.placeholder: The agent cites only what you paste here or labels the claim as unverified training knowledge.

name: Project Drafting Agent
description: Turns an idea into a structured outline, work plan and first-fortnight tasks.

fields.label: Project idea and objective
fields.placeholder: What should be different when this succeeds, and for whom?

name: Deadline Tracking Agent
description: Prioritises open work against capacity, flags conflicts and proposes date changes you can apply.

fields.label: Constraints this period
fields.placeholder: Travel, leave, fixed meetings, energy levels (optional)
